`final class DraggableProperty`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.property` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DraggableProperty.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/property/DraggableProperty.java)

How a node is dragged: the area it stays in, whether it moves or leaves a copy, and the targets it snaps to.

## Description

Create one with the factory of its area, then give it to [`Node.draggable`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-property-draggable).

## Learn more

- [Drag and drop](/use/learn/interactivity/drag-and-drop/)

<a id="DraggableProperty-method-getBounds"></a>

### getBounds

`BoundingBox getBounds(Node node)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The node … is dragged inside its parent but sits at the top of its UI, attach it to a node or pick another area such as DraggableProperty.ui()
- `IllegalStateException`: A free draggable area has no bounds, check getAreaType() before calling getBounds() or pick a bounded area such as DraggableProperty.parent()

The area that the node stays in, on the canvas.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` for a free drag, or for a `PARENT` area when the node has no parent.
